title: Cetera Improves Customer Experience with Oracle Cloud
description: Cetera Financial Group uses Oracle Cloud to support the second largest network of financial advisors in the US. Oracle Cloud streamlines the back office so Cetera can focus on a better advice experience.

asr.full_text: Here at Cetera, we provide tools, services, and technologies for independent financial advisors. Cetera is a big believer in transforming the value proposition for our advisors, our clients, and that starts with our customers, and it starts with our employees. Advice-centric experience defines how we think consumers want to consume financial advice in the future. As a technology-forward company, we wanted the ability to leverage innovation in the future through things like AI and robotics. As we embarked on our journey, our first decision was whether or not we would upgrade our existing solution. And as we evaluated Oracle versus other vendors, we had to first take into account the fact that we were a financial services firm. And financial services firms are heavily regulated. Traditionally, there's been a lot of resistance to moving financial applications to the cloud for financial services firm. And financial services firms are heavily regulated. Traditionally, there's been a lot of resistance to moving financial applications to the cloud for financial services companies. It's primarily based around security and data protection. What helped us to get comfortable early on was the fact that Oracle offered a cloud based service specifically for financial service companies. We already had Oracle HCM in the cloud, which is a system that we use to manage all of our human capital management needs as well as payroll. The interaction between the systems is seamless. We're now able to close our financials roughly two days faster than previously. It significantly improved the efficiency within my team in reducing the number of integration points. Making the decision to move to the cloud was a relatively easy one for us.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a business customer case study about Cetera using Oracle Cloud and related systems to support its operations. The apparent call to action promotes an Oracle Cloud product, with no described investment offer, required payment, credential request, or audience-directed financial participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content concerns an ordinary commercial cloud service, including its business use by Cetera and a destination for learning about Oracle Cloud. The evidence does not show a scam mechanism.
